title: Maya Hawke Joins Legendary‑Hasbro’s “Magic: The Gathering” Film Adaptation【Deadline】
body:
Maya Hawke, the 25‑year‑old star of Netflix’s “Stranger Things” and “Do Revenge,” has officially been tapped to lead the upcoming live‑action adaptation of the beloved trading‑card franchise *Magic: The Gathering*. The casting announcement, confirmed by insiders close to Legendary Entertainment and Hasbro Entertainment, marks the first major talent attachment for a project that has been quietly gestating for several years. Hawke’s involvement is expected to generate considerable buzz among both her growing fan base and the millions of players who have followed the game since its 1993 debut.

The film, which will be produced jointly by Legendary and Hasbro, aims to translate the complex multiverse of *Magic*—a world of planeswalkers, spell‑casting duels, and sprawling mythologies—into a cinematic experience that balances high‑octane action with the strategic depth that has kept the card game relevant across three decades. While details of the plot remain under wraps, early reports suggest the story will focus on a young planeswalker navigating a conflict that threatens to upend the fabric of the *Magic* multiverse. Hawke is rumored to portray a character inspired by the iconic “Liliana Vess” archetype, a powerful necromancer whose moral ambiguity could provide a compelling vehicle for the actress’s range.

Hawke’s casting is a strategic move that reflects a broader industry trend of leveraging rising young talent to anchor franchise films aimed at both nostalgic adults and a new generation of viewers. Having already proven her chops in genre‑bending series, she brings a blend of relatability and gravitas that could help demystify the often‑esoteric lore of *Magic* for newcomers. Moreover, her lineage—daughter of actors Ethan Hawke and Uma Thurman—adds a layer of Hollywood pedigree that may attract additional media attention and bolster the film’s marketability in an increasingly crowded slate of comic‑book and game adaptations.

The partnership between Legendary and Hasbro also signals a shift in how tabletop properties are being positioned for the big screen. Hasbro, which has successfully shepherded *Transformers* and *G.I. Joe* into blockbuster franchises, is now looking to replicate that formula with *Magic*, a property that boasts a fervent global community and a rich narrative tapestry. Legendary’s experience with large‑scale fantasy epics—most notably the *Jurassic World* and *Godzilla* franchises—provides the technical expertise and budgetary muscle required to render the game’s elaborate spell effects and otherworldly settings convincingly. Industry analysts predict that the collaboration could set a new benchmark for adapting card‑game universes, which have historically struggled to find a cinematic voice.

Fans of *Magic: The Gathering* have long expressed a desire for a faithful yet accessible film adaptation. Previous attempts, such as the 2022 animated series *War of the Spark*, were praised for their adherence to source material but lacked the mainstream reach of a live‑action feature. By attaching a recognizable name like Hawke and committing to a high‑budget production, the studios appear to be addressing both critical and commercial expectations. Early reactions on social media have been mixed—while many celebrate the casting news, some purists caution that the film must avoid oversimplifying the game’s intricate mechanics in favor of spectacle.

Production is slated to begin early next year, with a tentative release window aimed for the summer of 2025. As the project moves forward, further casting announcements and plot details are expected to surface, gradually shaping the narrative framework that will determine whether the film can satisfy the dual demands of storytelling and fan service. If successful, *Magic: The Gathering* could join the ranks of other tabletop adaptations that have crossed over into mainstream cinema, paving the way for future endeavors based on games, comics, and other niche media. For now, Maya Hawke’s involvement injects a fresh dose of excitement, suggesting that the upcoming movie may finally cast the spell that both gamers and moviegoers have been waiting for.
